title: Absecon roadwork closes shoulder along Delilah Road westbound - NewsBreak
text:
Atlantic County has issued the following traffic advisories for the week of June 30. The shoulder along the Delilah Road westbound on-ramp at the White Horse Pike (Rt. 30) will be in effect from 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Thursday for guide rail repair work, weather permitting. Motorists may experience minor delays and should plan travel time accordingly or seek an alternate route. Traffic directors will be on site to assist.
The northbound lane of Shore Road in Somers Point will be closed between Dawes and Ocean avenues from 6 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday this week, weather permitting. The southbound lane will remain open. Motorists should follow the posted detour and plan travel time accordingly or seek an alternate route. Police will be on site to assist.
Lane shifts will be in effect on English Creek Avenue between West Jersey Avenue and the Black Horse Pike in Egg Harbor Township from 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday through Thursday for restoration and guide rail work, weather permitting. Motorists should follow the posted work zone signs and plan travel time accordingly or seek an alternate route. Police and traffic directors will be on site to assist.
